Fca Boosted Apple (AAPL) Stake by $334,167; First Trust Bank LTD Has Increased Its Position in Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) by $713,700
June 18, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Fca Corp increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 48.47% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fca Corp bought 2,001 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 6,129 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.03 million, up from 4,128 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fca Corp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $928.18B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.03% or $1.96 during the last trading session, reaching $188.84. About 33.10M shares traded or 10.09% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500. First Trust Bank Ltd increased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 70.91% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. First Trust Bank Ltd bought 3,900 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.58% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 9,400 shares of the business services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.73 million, up from 5,500 at the end of the previous reported quarter. First Trust Bank Ltd who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $534.45 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.36% or $2.86 during the last trading session, reaching $208. About 28.67M shares traded or 64.10% up from the average. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 61.13% since June 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 48.56% the S&P500.
